'''Enemies''' ---- '''Enemies''' are the entities that you will be fighting in the game. They have a set amount of health that [[towers]] and [[units]] can reduce until it reaches zero, whereby the '''Enemy''' is killed. As the game progresses, stronger, and sometimes faster, '''Enemies''' will spawn. Some will even have special abilities to aid other '''Enemies''', while others can attack your [[towers]] and [[units]], affecting them in a negative way.
